    Function space versus weight space in NNs
    Figure 1 On the tension between the representation of functions in function space and in weight space in neural networks. We ‘see’ the outputs of neural networks as functions, generated by some inscrutable parameterization in terms of weights, which is more abstruse but also more tractable to learn in practice. Why might that be? When we can learn in function space many things work better in various sense (see, e.g. GP regression), but such methods rarely dominate in messy practice. Why might that be? When can we operate in function space? Sometimes we eeally want to, e.g. in operator learning.
